abstract: Delaying bill payments to public utilities may provide an important strategy for households with volatile incomes to smooth their consumption. At the same time, allowing late payments may reduce net revenues for utilities, which often leads to higher prices to cover costs. Using billing records from a large water utility in Manila, this paper estimates a household consumption and savings model to evaluate counterfactual payment policies. A popular proposal to ensure upfront payments—prepaid metering—recoups less revenue than is needed to compensate households for their loss of consumption smoothing. Alternatively, a revenue-neutral policy allowing more late payments increases welfare by encouraging greater consumption smoothing.
abstract_zh: 延迟支付公共事业账单可能为收入波动较大的家庭提供一种重要的消费平滑策略。同时，允许延迟支付可能会减少公用事业公司的净收入，这往往导致价格上涨以覆盖成本。利用马尼拉一家大型水务公司的账单记录，本文估计了一个家庭消费与储蓄模型，以评估反事实支付政策。一项确保预付款的流行提议——预付费计量——所回收的收入不足以补偿家庭因失去消费平滑而遭受的损失。相反，一项允许更多延迟支付的收入中性政策通过鼓励更大的消费平滑来增加福利。
title: Microcredit From Delaying Bill Payments
title_zh: 延迟支付账单的小额信贷

abstract: We introduce a dynamic factor correlation model whose core methodological innovation is a variation‐free parametrization of dynamic factor loadings, inspired by the generalized Fisher transformation. The model accommodates time‐varying correlations, heterogeneous heavy tails, and dependent idiosyncratic shocks. Applied to a Small Universe of 12 assets and a Large Universe of 323 stocks, the factor structure induces a sparse idiosyncratic correlation matrix with dependencies concentrated within subindustries, enabling scalability to high dimensions under a sparse block structure. Both factor loadings and correlations vary substantially. Allowing for heterogeneous heavy tails via convolution‐ distributions yields sizable improvements relative to Gaussian and multivariate‐ benchmarks.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种动态因子相关模型，其核心方法论创新在于受广义费舍尔变换启发的动态因子载荷的无变化参数化方法。该模型能够适应时变相关性、异质性厚尾以及相依的特异性冲击。将该模型应用于包含12项资产的小型资产池和包含323只股票的大型资产池时，因子结构产生了一个稀疏的特异性相关矩阵，其中依赖性集中在子行业内，从而在稀疏块结构下实现了对高维度的可扩展性。因子载荷与相关性均表现出显著变化。通过卷积分布允许异质性厚尾的存在，相较于高斯基准和多元基准，带来了显著的改进。
title: Dynamic Factor Correlations
title_zh: 动态因子相关性

abstract: This article examines gender differences in early childhood capability deprivation in Algeria, Morocco, Syria, and Yemen. Using nationally representative surveys from the Pan Arab Project for Family Health, we estimate deprivation among children aged 0-4 in three latent dimensions: nutrition, sanitation, and access to information. The empirical strategy combines a capability-deprivation framework with multi-group structural equation modelling, measurement-invariance tests, and multidimensional aggregation. The results show that gendered deprivation is neither uniform nor always to the disadvantage of girls. Female children are more likely to be capability deprived on aggregate in Algeria, Morocco, and Yemen, while male children appear more deprived in Syria. Gender disparities also vary across dimensions: boys are more likely to be nutrition-deprived in Morocco and Syria, while girls are more likely to be sanitation-deprived in Algeria and Morocco and information-deprived in Morocco and Yemen. Rural residence and low household-head education are generally associated with weaker achievements in nutrition, sanitation, and information. The findings contribute to applied research on child poverty measurement and gender inequality by showing that gendered capability deprivation is observable before school age and is patterned by household and public-service conditions.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了阿尔及利亚、摩洛哥、叙利亚和也门四国儿童早期能力剥夺的性别差异。基于泛阿拉伯家庭健康项目的全国代表性调查数据，我们估算了0-4岁儿童在营养、卫生设施和信息获取三个潜在维度上的剥夺状况。实证策略将能力剥夺框架与多组结构方程模型、测量不变性检验及多维聚合方法相结合。研究结果表明：性别化的剥夺既非均匀分布，也并非总是不利于女童。在阿尔及利亚、摩洛哥和也门，女童在综合指标上更易遭受能力剥夺，而叙利亚男童的剥夺程度则更为显著。性别差异在不同维度上呈现异质性：摩洛哥和叙利亚男童更易出现营养剥夺，阿尔及利亚和摩洛哥女童更易面临卫生设施剥夺，摩洛哥和也门女童则在信息获取方面处于劣势。农村居住环境与户主低教育水平通常与营养、卫生设施及信息获取方面的弱势表现相关。本研究通过揭示学龄前阶段已存在性别化的能力剥夺现象，且该现象受家庭与公共服务条件影响，为儿童贫困测量与性别不平等领域的应用研究提供了新证据。

title: Gendered Capability Deprivation in Early Childhood: Evidence from Four MENA Countries
title_zh: 早期儿童性别能力剥夺：来自四个中东和北非国家的证据

abstract: We study inference for threshold regression in the context of a large factor model with common stochastic trends. We develop a Least Squares estimator for the threshold level, deriving almost sure rates of convergence and proposing a novel way of constructing confidence intervals based on a randomized test. Our confidence intervals are constructed using the rates of convergence of the estimated threshold level, and no limiting distribution is required. We also develop a procedure to estimate the number of common trends in each regime, and investigate the properties of the Principal Component estimator for the loadings and common factors in both regimes. Our theoretical findings are corroborated through a comprehensive set of Monte Carlo experiments, and an application to equity prices and bond yields.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在具有共同随机趋势的大因子模型背景下阈值回归的推断问题。我们为阈值水平提出最小二乘估计量，推导几乎必然收敛速度，并提出一种基于随机化检验构建置信区间的新方法。我们的置信区间利用估计阈值水平的收敛速度构建，不需要极限分布。我们还提出一种估计每个机制中共同趋势数目的方法，并研究两种机制下载荷与共同因子的主成分估计量的性质。我们的理论发现通过一整套全面的蒙特卡洛实验以及对股票价格和债券收益率的应用得到验证。
title: High Dimensional Threshold Factor Models with Common Stochastic Trends
title_zh: 高维门限因子模型中的共同随机趋势

abstract: This paper measures and analyzes management practices in the Kenyan health care sector, drawing on a nationally representative survey and linked administrative data. The paper adapts the World Management Survey to measure management quality in primary health care facilities and hospitals, surveying 429 primary health care facilities and 73 hospitals. Primary health care facilities are the primary point of contact for most patients, providing treatment for common infectious diseases and chronic conditions, as well as services related to maternal and child health. Management quality is low on average, and the distribution is highly compressed. The analysis uses administrative data to test the association between the management quality and performance of primary health care facilities, measured by outpatient attendance, during a period of disruption that included the COVID-19 pandemic and a public health workers
abstract_zh: 本文基于全国代表性调查及关联行政数据，对肯尼亚医疗部门的管理实践进行了测度与分析。研究采用世界管理调查方法，对429家初级卫生保健机构和73家医院的管理质量进行评估。初级卫生保健机构作为多数患者的首要接触点，承担常见传染病、慢性病治疗及母婴健康相关服务。结果显示，管理质量整体偏低且分布高度集中。通过行政数据检验，本文分析了在包含新冠疫情及公共卫生工作者罢工的动荡时期，初级卫生保健机构管理质量与门诊就诊量绩效指标之间的关联性。
title: Management of Health Care Facilities and Patient Attendance during Major Disruptions: Evidence from Kenya
title_zh: 重大干扰期间医疗设施管理与患者就诊率：来自肯尼亚的证据

abstract: We show that banks do not decentralize the first best in a nominal Diamond–Dybvig economy with inside money. Furthermore, state‐contingent deposit contracts do not expand the consumption possibility set to include the first best either. Central banks can improve welfare but only for savers and only with unconventional monetary policy. Finally, central banks could prevent runs using their lender‐of‐last‐resort facility. These results suggest that, without an explicit incorporation of inside money, it is not trivial to provide a theoretical argument about the ability of the banking sector to efficiently supply liquidity in our economies.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，在包含内部货币的名义Diamond–Dybvig经济中，银行无法实现最优分散化配置。此外，状态依存的存款合约也无法将消费可能性集合扩展至包含最优结果。中央银行虽能提升福利，但仅限于储蓄者，且需借助非常规货币政策。最后，中央银行可通过其最后贷款人机制来防止挤兑。这些结果表明，若不明确纳入内部货币，则难以就银行部门在我们经济中有效提供流动性的能力给出理论论证。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Banking with Inside Money: An Efficiency Analysis
title_zh: 内部货币银行：效率分析

abstract: This paper proposes a two-sector production model augmented with the endogenous preference evolution mechanism. The preference evolution reflects the popularity of two sectors among investors and captures the idea that preferences for the two goods move endogenously over time. The interaction of preference evolution and market-clearing mechanism generates endogenous movements in Tobin’s Q, risk premia and wealth shares different to the standard production economy of Eberly and Wang (2011). The model also implies that wealth fluctuates across sectors due to the shifts in preferences and subsequently because of expected returns and Sharpe ratios. In the empirical tests, I calibrate the baseline model to the US data sample over 1975–2019 and verify that model predictions are supported in the data.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一个包含内生偏好演化机制的两部门生产模型。偏好演化反映了投资者对两个部门的偏好程度，并捕捉了两种商品偏好随时间内生变动的思想。偏好演化与市场出清机制的相互作用，产生了托宾Q、风险溢价和财富份额的内生变动，这与Eberly和Wang（2011）的标准生产经济有所不同。模型还表明，由于偏好变化，以及随后预期收益和夏普比率的变动，财富在各部门间发生波动。在实证检验中，我将基准模型校准至1975年至2019年的美国数据样本，并验证了模型预测在数据中得到支持。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Production and endogenous preferences
title_zh: 生产与内生偏好

abstract: This paper investigates whether firms that are more open to international trade engage more extensively in efforts to reduce the environmental impact of their activities by adopting environment-friendly strategies (i.e., implementing new practices and technologies that reduce pollution and resource use). In particular, we examine the direction of this relationship for different levels of industry integration in Global Value Chains (GVCs) and different degrees of GVC trade partners’ environmental performance. Our econometric analysis uses data from 4,886 manufacturing firms from 21 lower and upper middle-income countries in Central Asia, Eastern Europe and the Middle East and North Africa. The results suggest a positive association between firm openness to international markets and intensity of use of environmentally friendly practices and technologies. This relationship becomes stronger for higher levels of environmental performance by industry GVC partners and weaker levels of industry integration in GVC.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了那些对国际贸易更为开放的企业，是否会更积极地采取环保策略（即实施减少污染和资源使用的新实践与技术）以降低其活动对环境的影响。具体而言，我们考察了在不同行业全球价值链（GVC）整合水平及不同GVC贸易伙伴环境绩效程度下，这一关系的方向性。我们的计量分析使用了来自中亚、东欧以及中东和北非地区21个中低收入和中等偏上收入国家的4，886家制造业企业的数据。结果表明，企业对国际市场的开放程度与环保实践和技术的使用强度之间存在正相关关系。当行业GVC伙伴的环境绩效较高时，这种关系更为显著；而当行业在GVC中的整合程度较低时，这种关系则较弱。
title: Trade openness, global value chain integration and firms’ adoption of environment-friendly strategies
title_zh: 贸易开放、全球价值链整合与企业环境友好型战略的采纳

abstract: The dollar shortage debate—Paul Samuelson called it “the big open question of our time”—dominated international macroeconomics in the 15 years following the end of World War II. There were two main views regarding its cause: financial frictions that limited capital flows to Western Europe (Kindleberger); and overvalued fixed exchange rates versus the US dollar (Friedman). According to Kindleberger the dollar shortage was attenuated by two real factors that contributed to current account deficits: a large technological gap between the United States and Europe; and European impatience to improve living standards. Kindleberger believed that the current account deficit would prove chronic because of the persistence of the productivity gap, a view that was challenged by Bloomfield who argued that it would dissipate through income growth in Europe. We argue that Kindelberger’s analytical framework is closely connected to the modern intertemporal approach to current account determination; and, also, that the international reserve function of the US dollar—the Triffin dilemma—did not play a role in the dollar shortage.
abstract_zh: 美元短缺的争论——保罗·萨缪尔森称之为“我们时代悬而未决的重大问题”——在二战结束后的15年间主导了国际宏观经济学领域。关于其成因存在两种主要观点：一是限制资本流向西欧的金融摩擦（金德尔伯格）；二是相对于美元被高估的固定汇率（弗里德曼）。金德尔伯格认为，美元短缺因两个导致经常账户赤字的实际因素而减弱：美国与欧洲之间巨大的技术差距；以及欧洲改善生活水平的迫切需求。金德尔伯格认为，由于生产率差距的持续性，经常账户赤字将被证明是长期性的，这一观点遭到布卢姆菲尔德的质疑，后者认为该赤字将随着欧洲收入增长而消散。我们论证：金德尔伯格的分析框架与现代跨期经常账户决定理论密切相关；同时，美元的国际储备功能——特里芬难题——在美元短缺中并未发挥作用。
title: Retrospectives: The Great Dollar-Shortage Debate
title_zh: 回顾：美元短缺大辩论

abstract: Recommendations for Further Reading by Timothy Taylor. Published in volume 40, issue 2, pages 259-66 of Journal of Economic Perspectives, Spring 2026
abstract_zh: 蒂莫西·泰勒的《延伸阅读推荐》。发表于《经济展望杂志》2026年春季第40卷第2期，第259-266页。
title: Recommendations for Further Reading
title_zh: 进一步阅读建议

abstract: This paper studies the pricing implications of wholesale and agency contracts when input terms are determined through bargaining. We develop a structural Nash-in-Nash bargaining model and show that the distribution of bargaining power determines whether agency contracts raise or lower retail prices relative to wholesale contracts. We apply the model to the e-book market, which transitioned from wholesale to agency contracts after the expiration of a ban on agency contracting. Estimates indicate that the retailers have most of the bargaining power. Counterfactual simulations show that most-favored-nation clauses raise prices but would lower the profits of the publishers and Amazon. (JEL C78, D86, K21, L14, L42, L81, L82)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了当投入条款通过谈判确定时，批发合同与代理合同对定价的影响。我们构建了一个结构化的纳什-纳什谈判模型，并证明谈判力的分布决定了代理合同相对于批发合同是提高还是降低零售价格。我们将该模型应用于电子书市场，该市场在代理合同禁令到期后从批发合同转向代理合同。估计结果表明，零售商拥有大部分谈判力。反事实模拟显示，最惠国待遇条款会提高价格，但会降低出版商和亚马逊的利润。（JEL C78, D86, K21, L14, L42, L81, L82）
title: Agency Pricing and Bargaining: Evidence from the E-Book Market
title_zh: 代理定价与议价：来自电子书市场的证据

abstract: We study the possibility of identifying time-inconsistent preferences in empirical designs where preferences are elicited in advance at time 0 and then again at time 1, after the agent receives additional information. For single-peaked preferences, time consistency is rejected only when the time-1 ranking between a pair of alternatives is always the reverse of the time-0 ranking. We establish variations and generalizations of this result. Since such stark reversals are rarely observed, choice-revision designs require stronger identification assumptions than perhaps previously appreciated. But we show that time inconsistency is identifiable in environments where preferences over alternatives can be “priced out.” (JEL D11, D15, D83, D86)
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在实证设计中识别时间不一致偏好的可能性，其中偏好是在时间0提前引出，并在时间1（代理人获得额外信息后）再次引出。对于单峰偏好，只有当时间1对某对备选方案的排序始终与时间0的排序相反时，时间一致性才被拒绝。我们建立了这一结果的变体与推广形式。由于这种截然相反的逆转现象极少被观察到，选择修正设计所需的识别假设可能比以往所认知的更为严格。但我们证明，在能够对备选方案偏好进行“定价”的环境中，时间不一致性是可识别的。（JEL D11, D15, D83, D86）
title: Dynamic Preference "Reversals" and Time Inconsistency
title_zh: 动态偏好“逆转”与时间不一致性

abstract: Penny-picking refers to the often-observed phenomenon of repeatedly taking negatively skewed risks and seems directly at odds with evidence on (positive-)skewness-seeking as observed in static settings. We show that penny-picking may not only occur despite skewness-seeking, but—seemingly paradoxically—because of skewness-seeking. With sufficient time available, risks with arbitrary negative skewness can be gambled in such a way that, overall, skewness is positive. Therefore, classical behavioral theories like prospect theory straightforwardly explain penny-picking. More generally, we show that the versatile dynamics of skewness reconcile apparent preference reversals concerning the avoidance and acceptance of (skewed and non-skewed) risks. (JEL D81, D91, G11, G41)
abstract_zh: 捡硬币”现象指反复承担负偏态风险的常见行为，这与静态环境下观察到的（正）偏态偏好证据直接矛盾。我们证明，捡硬币行为不仅可能发生在偏态偏好存在的情况下，而且——看似矛盾地——恰恰源于偏态偏好。当时间足够充裕时，任意负偏态风险可通过特定博弈方式转化为整体正偏态。因此，前景理论等经典行为理论能直接解释捡硬币现象。更一般地，我们揭示了偏态的动态特性如何调和了关于规避与接受（偏态与非偏态）风险的表面偏好反转现象。（JEL D81, D91, G11, G41）
title: On Taking a Skewed Risk More than Once
title_zh: 关于多次承担偏斜风险

abstract: A group of agents with ex ante independent and identically uncertain quality compete for a prize, awarded by a principal. Agents may possess evidence about the quality of those they share a social connection with (neighbors), and themselves. In one equilibrium, adversarial disclosure of evidence leads the principal to statistically discriminate between agents based on their number of neighbors (degree). We identify parameter values for which an agent’s ex ante winning probability is monotone in degree. All equilibria that satisfy some robustness criteria lie between this adversarial disclosure equilibrium and a less informative one that features no snitching and no discrimination. (JEL D82, D83, D85, Z13)
abstract_zh: 一群事前独立且同分布质量不确定的代理人竞争由委托人授予的奖项。代理人可能掌握其社交关系对象（邻居）及自身质量的证据。在某一均衡中，证据的对抗性披露导致委托人根据代理人拥有的邻居数量（度数）进行统计性歧视。我们识别出使代理人事前获胜概率随度数单调变化的参数区间。所有满足某些稳健性标准的均衡均介于该对抗性披露均衡与一个信息量更少（无告密且无歧视）的均衡之间。（JEL D82, D83, D85, Z13）
title: Strategic Evidence Disclosure in Networks and Equilibrium Discrimination
title_zh: 网络中的策略性证据披露与均衡歧视

abstract: We study quality distortions when firms hold market power. We develop a model allowing for flexible functional forms of demand in order to extend Spence’s (1975) monopoly analysis to imperfect competition. We show that quality distortions are determined by a competition effect that captures the externality a firm exerts on its competitors when raising both its price and its quality, in addition to Spence’s (1975) effect related to the shape of total market demand. Our approach also allows us to analyze the effects of commodity taxation and technology shocks on the equilibrium allocation when firms compete in prices and qualities. (JEL D43, D62, H22, L13, L15, O31)
abstract_zh: 本文研究企业在拥有市场势力时的质量扭曲问题。我们构建了一个允许需求函数具有灵活形式的模型，将斯彭斯（1975）的垄断分析拓展至不完全竞争市场。研究表明，质量扭曲由竞争效应决定——该效应捕捉了企业在同时提高价格与质量时对竞争对手产生的外部性，此外还包含斯彭斯（1975）提出的与总市场需求形态相关的效应。我们的方法还允许分析当企业在价格与质量维度展开竞争时，商品税与技术冲击对均衡配置的影响。（JEL分类号：D43, D62, H22, L13, L15, O31）
title: Quality and Imperfect Competition
title_zh: 质量与不完全竞争

abstract: Why do firms outsource research and development (R&D) for some products while conducting R&D in-house for similar ones? An innovating firm risks cannibalizing its existing products. The more profitable these products, the more the firm wants to limit cannibalization. We apply this logic to the organization of R&D by introducing a novel theoretical model in which developing in-house provides the firm more control over the new product’s location in product space. An empirical analysis of our testable predictions using pharmaceutical data concerning patents, patent expiration, and outsourcing at various stages of the R&D process supports our theoretical approach. (JEL D21, D22, L22, L24, L65, O31, O34)
abstract_zh: 为什么企业会对某些产品外包研发，而对类似产品进行内部研发？创新企业面临蚕食现有产品的风险。现有产品利润越高，企业就越想限制这种蚕食。我们将这一逻辑应用于研发组织方式，提出了一个新颖的理论模型：内部研发能让企业更好地控制新产品在产品空间中的定位。我们利用制药行业关于专利、专利到期以及研发各阶段外包的数据，对可检验的预测进行了实证分析，结果支持了我们的理论方法。（JEL D21, D22, L22, L24, L65, O31, O34）
title: The Organization of Innovation: Incomplete Contracts and the Outsourcing Decision
title_zh: 创新的组织：不完全合同与外包决策

abstract: We study the effect of a merger on R&D activity in a dynamic model with uncertainty about the feasibility of innovation. The merger has three effects: It may reduce the number of follow-up innovations (cannibalization effect), increase the probability of the first game-changer innovation (appropriability effect), and bring this innovation forward in time (informational effect). The model suggests mergers are more desirable when R&D outcomes are highly uncertain, but less so when the innovation path is clearer. A surprising policy implication is that the benefit of the merger may be higher if the first and subsequent innovations are closer substitutes. (JEL D21, D83, G34, O31)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在创新可行性不确定的动态模型中，并购对研发活动的影响。并购具有三种效应：可能减少后续创新的数量（蚕食效应）、提高首个颠覆性创新的概率（占有效应），以及使该创新提前实现（信息效应）。模型表明，当研发结果高度不确定时，并购更可取；而当创新路径较为清晰时，并购的吸引力则较低。一个令人意外的政策启示是：若首次创新与后续创新之间的替代性越强，并购的收益可能越高。（JEL D21, D83, G34, O31）
title: The Effect of Mergers on Innovation
title_zh: 并购对创新的影响

abstract: This paper examines efficient allocations in economies where consumers exhibit heterogeneous smooth ambiguity preferences and face model uncertainty with a common set of identifiable models. Aggregate endowment is ambiguous. We characterize economies where the representative consumer is of the smooth ambiguity type and derive efficient sharing rules. Heterogeneous ambiguity aversion leads to sharing rules that systematically differ from those in vNM economies. The representative consumer’s ambiguity aversion differs from that of the typical consumer; this leads to more compelling asset-pricing predictions. We focus on point-identified models but show that our insights extend to partially identified models. (JEL D11, D61, D81, E32, G12)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了消费者具有异质性平滑模糊偏好且面临共同可识别模型集下的模型不确定性时的经济有效配置问题。总禀赋具有模糊性。我们刻画了代表性消费者属于平滑模糊类型的经济体特征，并推导出有效的风险分担规则。异质性模糊厌恶导致的风险分担规则与vNM经济体中的规则存在系统性差异。代表性消费者的模糊厌恶程度与典型消费者不同，这产生了更具说服力的资产定价预测。本文重点研究点识别模型，但论证了相关见解可推广至部分识别模型。（JEL分类号：D11, D61, D81, E32, G12）
title: Sharing Model Uncertainty
title_zh: 共享模型不确定性

abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel way to measure behavioral heterogeneity in a population of stochastic individuals. Our measure is choice-based; it evaluates the probability that, over a randomly selected menu, the sampled choices of two sampled individuals differ. We provide axiomatic foundations for this measure and a decomposition result that separates heterogeneity into its intrapersonal and interpersonal components. (JEL D01, D11, D91)
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种衡量随机个体群体中行为异质性的新方法。该度量基于选择行为，评估在随机选取的菜单上，两个随机个体的抽样选择存在差异的概率。我们为这一度量提供了公理化基础，并给出了一个分解结果，将异质性区分为个体内与个体间两个组成部分。（JEL D01, D11, D91）
title: A Measure of Behavioral Heterogeneity
title_zh: 行为异质性的度量

abstract: We introduce a new type of games, called “opportunity-hunting games,” in which two players compete to discover an uncertain event (“opportunity”) that occurs at an unobserved and random point in time. Players can inspect whether the event has already occurred again and again, but each inspection is costly. Varying the parameters of the model spans the range from games where competition between the players to be the first to identify the opportunity is the dominant force, to games in which free riding on the other player’s effort is the dominant force. We characterize the game’s unique symmetric Markov perfect equilibrium. (JEL C72, C73)
abstract_zh: 我们引入了一类新型博弈，称为“机会搜寻博弈”。在该博弈中，两个参与者竞相发现一个在未观测到的随机时间点发生的不确定事件（即“机会”）。参与者可以反复检查该事件是否已经发生，但每次检查都需要付出成本。通过调整模型参数，该博弈涵盖了从“抢先识别机会的竞争”为主导力量，到“搭便车利用对方努力”为主导力量的全范围情形。我们刻画了该博弈唯一的对称马尔可夫完美均衡。（JEL分类号：C72, C73）
title: Opportunity Hunters: A Model of Competitive Sequential Inspections
title_zh: 机会猎手：竞争性序贯检查模型

abstract: This paper measures concentration in narrowly defined product markets for a broad range of consumer goods and services in the United States from 1994 to 2019. We document two main empirical facts. First, concentration levels are high. Of the markets in our sample, 44.4 percent are “highly concentrated” as defined by US regulators. Second, market concentration has been decreasing since 1994. The median HHI falls from 2,362 to 2,045. These findings stand in stark contrast to the prior literature, which uses market definitions that are aggregated to a level that is typically too broad to accurately reflect competition in consumer markets. (JEL D43, L13, M37, R32)
abstract_zh: 本文以1994年至2019年美国广泛消费品与服务市场为对象，在狭义产品市场层面测度市场集中度。我们揭示了两项主要实证发现：第一，市场集中度水平较高。按美国监管机构定义，样本中44.4%的市场属于"高度集中"市场。第二，自1994年以来市场集中度持续下降，赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数中位数从2,362降至2,045。这些发现与既有文献形成鲜明对比——既有研究采用的市场定义通常过于宽泛，难以准确反映消费品市场的竞争状况。(JEL D43, L13, M37, R32)
title: Concentration in Product Markets
title_zh: 产品市场集中度

abstract: Complementarities and peer effects are common in matching markets, yet incorporating them often leads to nonexistence of stable matchings. We observe that matching is often an ongoing process rather than a static allocation, where long-lived firms interact over time with short-lived workers. We show that when wages are flexible and firms are sufficiently patient, a dynamically stable solution always exists in many-to-one matching markets — even with complementarities and peer effects. Flexible wages are crucial to our result, as they not only facilitate surplus extraction when firms cooperate in no-poaching agreements but also enhance the threat of punishment through bidding wars. (JEL C72, C73, C78, D21, D62, J31, J41)
abstract_zh: 互补性与同伴效应在匹配市场中普遍存在，但将其纳入模型往往导致稳定匹配的缺失。我们观察到，匹配通常是一个持续的过程而非静态配置——长期存续的企业与短期工作的劳动者会随时间推移持续互动。研究表明，在工资具有灵活性且企业具备充分耐心的条件下，多对一匹配市场中始终存在动态稳定解——即便存在互补性与同伴效应。灵活工资机制对结论至关重要：它不仅在企业达成互不挖角协议时促进剩余提取，更能通过竞价战强化惩罚威胁。（JEL分类号：C72, C73, C78, D21, D62, J31, J41）
title: Self-Enforced Job Matching
title_zh: 自我执行的岗位匹配

abstract: Does more information benefit voters? I examine this question in a novel setting of distributive politics and electoral accountability. Homogeneously informed electorates can benefit from less information through improvements in the control or screening of politicians. For heterogeneously informed electorates, I show that the distribution of resources and voter welfare is affected by the nature of informational heterogeneity and by voters’ ability to communicate with each other, making less-informed voters better off than their more-informed counterparts in some cases. (JEL D72, D82, D83, H50)
abstract_zh: 更多信息是否有利于选民？我在分配政治与选举问责这一新颖情境中探讨了该问题。信息同质的选民群体可能因信息减少而受益，这源于对政治家控制或筛选机制的改善。对于信息异质的选民群体，研究表明资源分配与选民福利受信息异质性特征及选民间沟通能力的影响，在某些情况下信息较少的选民反而比信息更多的选民处境更优。（JEL D72, D82, D83, H50）
title: Voter Information and Distributive Politics
title_zh: 选民信息与分配政治

abstract: We examine whether vertical integration of hospitals and skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) could lessen competition by foreclosing rival SNFs’ access to lucrative referrals. We find that it could: Among integrated providers, a 1 percent increase in SNF reimbursement for a given patient discharged from the upstream hospital increases the self-referral rate to the hospital’s downstream SNF(s) by 1.8 percent. We find no evidence of offsetting benefits for patients and payers: These increased self-referrals have an imprecisely estimated zero effect on patient outcomes and Medicare spending. (JEL G34, I11, I13, J14, L14, L22)
abstract_zh: 本文考察了医院与专业护理机构（SNFs）的纵向整合是否可能通过阻断竞争性SNFs获取高利润转诊渠道而削弱市场竞争。研究发现确实存在此效应：在整合型医疗服务提供者中，上游医院出院患者的SNF报销比例每增加1%，该医院向下游自有SNF的自我转诊率将提升1.8%。未发现对患者及支付方存在补偿性收益的证据：这些增加的自我转诊对患者预后及医保支出的影响呈现不精确的零效应。（JEL分类号：G34, I11, I13, J14, L14, L22）
title: Vertical Integration and Cream Skimming of Profitable Referrals: The Case of Hospital-Owned Skilled Nursing Facilities
title_zh: 纵向整合与盈利转诊的“撇脂”行为：以医院自营专业护理机构为例

abstract: I investigate the intrahousehold labor and resource allocation consequences of an employment guarantee targeting rural households in India. The guarantee insures household earnings, replacing women as added workers and shutting down a motive for saving. Despite sizable program-job take-up, the guarantee decreases participation in other working activities and, thus, labor force participation of married women and total time worked by their husbands. The guarantee accounts for up to 30 percent of a recent countrywide decrease in rural female labor force participation. Though it increases household consumption, the guarantee reduces the command of women’s household earnings and, thereby, their well-being. (JEL D13, G51, I32, J16, J22, J68, O12)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了印度农村家庭就业保障计划对家庭内部劳动与资源配置的影响。该保障计划为家庭收入提供保险，替代了女性作为补充劳动力的角色，并消除了储蓄动机。尽管该计划下的项目就业参与率较高，但它减少了其他工作活动的参与，从而降低了已婚女性的劳动参与率及其丈夫的总工作时间。该计划可解释近期全国农村女性劳动参与率下降的30%。虽然该计划增加了家庭消费，但它削弱了女性对家庭收入的支配权，进而降低了其福利水平。（JEL分类号：D13, G51, I32, J16, J22, J68, O12）
title: Guaranteed Employment in Rural India: Intrahousehold Labor and Resource Allocation Consequences
title_zh: 印度农村的就业保障：家庭内劳动力与资源配置效应

abstract: We study the role of international financial integration in buffering natural disaster shocks, using a large sample of advanced and emerging economies. Natural disasters are largely unpredictable and unrelated to the state of financial integration. We document that integration improves the absorption of such shocks: Output, consumption, and investment are significantly higher after a natural disaster in states with high than in states with low integration. The benefits are most clear for advanced economies. Emerging markets tend to profit from financial integration, too, but the estimates are less precise unless we condition on institutional quality or consider only debt assets. (JEL E21, E22, E23, F32, F33, F34, Q54)
abstract_zh: 本文利用发达经济体与新兴经济体的广泛样本，研究国际金融一体化在缓冲自然灾害冲击中的作用。自然灾害在很大程度上具有不可预测性，且与金融一体化程度无关。我们证实，金融一体化能够改善此类冲击的吸收效果：在自然灾害发生后，金融一体化程度较高的经济体，其产出、消费和投资水平显著高于一体化程度较低的经济体。这种效益在发达经济体中最为明显。新兴市场同样能从金融一体化中获益，但除非我们以制度质量作为条件或仅考虑债务资产，否则相关估计结果的精确度较低。（JEL分类号：E21, E22, E23, F32, F33, F34, Q54）
title: Integrating Out Natural Disaster Shocks
title_zh: 整合自然灾难冲击

abstract: This paper develops a structural model of endogenous product attribute choice in the presence of indirect network effects to study electric vehicle (EV) subsidies. Using data on the German EV market, I find that a support scheme almost doubled EV sales but substantially affected EVs’ price and driving range. These adjustments create a trade-off between optimizing different policy objectives when designing subsidies. Large purchase subsidies maximize EV sales, whereas large charging station subsidies maximize consumer and total surplus. The results suggest that maximizing EV sales can lead to unintended consequences in the form of price and range adjustments. (JEL D12, D22, D85, H25, L14, L62, R41)
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个存在间接网络效应时内生产品属性选择的结构模型，用以研究电动汽车补贴政策。基于德国电动汽车市场数据，我发现补贴计划使电动汽车销量几乎翻倍，但显著影响了其价格与续航里程。这些调整在设计补贴时形成了不同政策目标之间的权衡：高额购车补贴能最大化电动汽车销量，而高额充电站补贴则能最大化消费者剩余与总剩余。研究结果表明，追求销量最大化可能导致价格与续航里程调整等非预期后果。（JEL分类号：D12, D22, D85, H25, L14, L62, R41）
title: Adjustable Product Attributes, Indirect Network Effects, and Subsidy Design: The Case of Electric Vehicles
title_zh: 可调整产品属性、间接网络效应与补贴设计：以电动汽车为例

abstract: We evaluate a tax reform in Ecuador that introduced generous deductions from personal income taxes (PIT), encouraging consumers to request receipts. The reform addresses tax evasion by targeting small self-employed businesses that mainly sell goods or services not subject to value-added taxes (VAT) but that often evade income taxes. Exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in receipt demand due to the distribution of taxpayers across regions and professions, we find significant increases in reported profits among self-employed businesses exposed to the reform. We document spillover effects on VAT. Our net-revenue impact analysis suggests the additional tax payments outweigh the foregone tax revenue. (JEL H24, H25, H26, J23, K34, O17)
abstract_zh: 我们评估了厄瓜多尔的一项税制改革，该改革引入了慷慨的个人所得税（PIT）扣除项，鼓励消费者索取收据。这项改革通过针对主要销售不征收增值税（VAT）的商品或服务、但常逃避所得税的小型个体经营企业，来应对逃税问题。利用纳税人跨地区和职业分布带来的收据需求外生性变化，我们发现受改革影响的个体经营企业报告利润显著增加。我们记录了改革对增值税的溢出效应。净收入影响分析表明，额外税收收入超过了放弃的税收收入。（JEL H24, H25, H26, J23, K34, O17）
title: Harnessing Deductions to Increase Tax Compliance and Formalization
title_zh: 利用扣除额提高税收合规性与正规化

abstract: We study rental income tax compliance using novel third-party information and a large-scale randomized field experiment. The third-party information combines register data on the ownership and occupancy of apartments. The RCT used this new third-party information in the targeting and design of experimental treatments, and increased the propensity to report rental income and the amount of reported rental income net of expenses. Our research design also allows us to identify members of ownership networks and analyze spillover effects in tax enforcement between them. We find positive reporting spillovers. We do not find evidence of real effects on asset market transactions. (JEL C93, D83, H26, K34, R31)
abstract_zh: 我们利用新颖的第三方信息和大规模随机实地实验，对租金收入纳税遵从度展开研究。该第三方信息整合了公寓所有权与居住情况的登记数据。随机对照实验将这一新型第三方信息应用于实验干预的目标定位与设计，显著提升了租金收入的申报倾向及扣除费用后的申报金额。研究设计还使我们能够识别所有权网络成员，并分析税收执法在成员间的溢出效应。研究发现存在正向的申报溢出效应，但未发现对资产市场交易产生实质性影响的证据。（JEL分类号：C93, D83, H26, K34, R31）
title: Tax Compliance in the Rental Housing Market: Evidence from a Field Experiment
title_zh: 租赁住房市场中的税收遵从：来自实地实验的证据

abstract: We show that exposure to extreme temperatures significantly increases international migration from El Salvador, where nearly a quarter of the population lives in the United States. Extreme temperatures reduce corn yields, leading producers to decrease their use of postharvest inputs and demand for agricultural workers. These income losses, combined with established US migration networks, increase emigration. Our findings highlight how international migration serves as a response to extreme temperatures when destination networks are strong and migration remains financially feasible. This pattern is not unique to El Salvador: Roughly 30 million farms globally are in low-income settings with access to remittances. (JEL F24, J15, J23, J43, O15, Q12, Q54)
abstract_zh: 研究表明，极端气温显著增加了萨尔瓦多的国际移民——该国近四分之一人口居住在美国。极端气温导致玉米减产，促使生产者减少收获后投入品的使用并降低对农业劳动力的需求。这些收入损失，加上已建立的美国移民网络，进一步推动了移民潮。我们的发现凸显了当目的地移民网络强大且移民在经济上仍可行时，国际移民如何成为应对极端气温的一种手段。这一现象并非萨尔瓦多独有：全球约有3000万个农场位于低收入地区，且这些地区能够获得汇款。（JEL分类号：F24, J15, J23, J43, O15, Q12, Q54）
title: Responses to Extreme Temperatures: Migrant Networks and International Migration from El Salvador
title_zh: 极端温度的反应：移民网络与萨尔瓦多的国际移民

abstract: I study the effects of charters on student racial segregation, identifying a novel mechanism: the assignment of White and non-White students to regular classrooms within their school-grade. Exploiting almost 100 entries of elementary charters in North Carolina from 1997 to 2015, I show that the announcement of an opening significantly increases classroom segregation within public schools nearby, relative to schools farther away, especially within non-majority-White schools and for charter openings that enroll a relatively large share of White students. Accounting for classrooms is unlikely to reverse the literature’s conclusion that the charter effects on student segregation are modest in magnitude. (JEL H75, I21, I24, I28, J15)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了特许学校对学生种族隔离的影响，并识别出一种新机制：白人和非白人学生在其所在年级的常规班级中的分配。利用1997年至2015年间北卡罗来纳州近100所小学特许学校的设立数据，我表明，与距离较远的学校相比，特许学校开学的公告显著增加了附近公立学校内部的班级隔离，尤其是在非白人占多数的学校以及招收白人学生比例相对较高的特许学校中。考虑班级层面的因素不太可能推翻文献中关于特许学校对学生隔离影响程度较小的结论。（JEL H75, I21, I24, I28, J15）
title: The Segregative Effects of Charter Schools
title_zh: 特许学校的隔离效应

abstract: We study the effect of stricter enforcement of the dividend-withholding tax (DWT). We focus on a 2016 Danish enforcement reform and compare Denmark to its Nordic neighbors. Throughout the Nordic stock markets, shares on loan spike sharply around dividend dates. These spikes are consistent with abuse of the DWT system. Postreform, spikes in Denmark disappear, and annual DWT revenue increases by 130 percent. Enforcement does not harm the investment climate as measured by Danish stock returns, investment rate, and dividend yield. (JEL G18, G35, G38, H26, K22, K34)
abstract_zh: 我们研究了股息预扣税（DWT）执行力度加强的影响。重点关注2016年丹麦的一项执法改革，并将丹麦与其北欧邻国进行比较。在整个北欧股票市场中，股票借贷量在股息发放日前后急剧飙升。这些飙升现象与DWT制度的滥用行为相符。改革后，丹麦的此类飙升现象消失，年度DWT收入增长130%。以丹麦股票回报率、投资率和股息收益率衡量，执法并未损害投资环境。（JEL分类号：G18, G35, G38, H26, K22, K34）
title: The Big Short (Interest): Closing the Loopholes in the Dividend-Withholding Tax
title_zh: 大空头（空头利息）：堵塞股息预扣税漏洞

abstract: A large literature has documented that fiscal policy is procyclical in emerging markets/developing countries and acyclical/countercyclical in advanced economies. This paper analyzes fiscal procyclicality in commodity-exporting countries. The paper makes two novel contributions. First, based on the “when it rains, it pours” phenomenon (that is, contractionary fiscal policy amplifies the business cycle), the paper shows that, on average, government spending magnifies the business cycle by 21 percent of the initial drop in output following a fall in commodity prices. Second, the paper estimates the welfare costs of fiscal procyclicality at 36 percent of the commodity business cycle. (JEL E32, E62, F14, H50, O19, Q02)
abstract_zh: 大量文献表明，财政政策在新兴市场/发展中国家呈现顺周期性，而在发达经济体中则为非周期性/逆周期性。本文分析了大宗商品出口国的财政顺周期性，并做出两项创新性贡献。首先，基于"祸不单行"现象（即紧缩性财政政策放大经济周期），本文证明：在大宗商品价格下跌后，政府支出平均会使初始产出下降的幅度放大21%。其次，本文估算出财政顺周期性的福利成本相当于大宗商品经济周期的36%。（JEL分类号：E32, E62, F14, H50, O19, Q02）
title: Fiscal Procyclicality in Commodity Exporting Countries: How Much Does It Pour and Why?
title_zh: 大宗商品出口国的财政顺周期性：程度与成因

abstract: We estimate the direct and spillover effects of cannabis legalization on longstanding racial disparities in criminal justice outcomes. We find that legalization reduces cannabis possession and sales arrests for White and Black populations, narrowing but not eliminating disparities. We also find spillover increases in hospitalizations involving cannabis and other illegal drugs. However, spillovers on arrests, incarcerations, and crimes involving serious violent or property offenses are insignificant or even decrease. Other illegal drug sales arrests decrease across populations, while illegal drug incarcerations decrease only among White populations. Spillovers on other low-level offenses are insignificant for White but mixed for Black populations. (JEL I12, J15, K14, K41, K42)
abstract_zh: 我们估算了大麻合法化对刑事司法结果中长期存在的种族差异的直接效应与溢出效应。研究发现，合法化减少了白人和黑人群体中因持有和销售大麻而被逮捕的数量，缩小了差异但并未完全消除。同时，溢出效应导致涉及大麻及其他非法药物的住院人数增加。然而，对涉及严重暴力或财产犯罪的逮捕、监禁及犯罪行为的溢出效应并不显著，甚至有所下降。其他非法药物销售逮捕人数在各群体中均减少，但非法药物监禁人数仅在白人群体中下降。对白人群体而言，其他轻微犯罪的溢出效应不显著，而对黑人群体则呈现混合结果。（JEL I12, J15, K14, K41, K42）
title: State Recreational Cannabis Laws and Racial Disparities in the Criminal Legal System
title_zh: 州娱乐性大麻法律与刑事司法系统中的种族差异

abstract: Incarceration is often justified by a defendant’s risk of future crime. To what extent do biased beliefs about predictors of crime distort incarceration decisions? We survey prosecutors about how violent rearrest rates vary by defendant age and criminal history. Surveyed prosecutors make systematic errors: They underestimate the decline in rearrest with age and overestimate the increase with criminal history. By linking prosecutors’ beliefs to their quasi-randomly assigned cases, we show that prosecutors’ beliefs predict incarceration patterns by defendant age and criminal history in their cases. Finally, we find that prosecutors with more accurate beliefs simultaneously reduce violent rearrest and incarceration. (JEL D83, K14, K41, K42)
abstract_zh: 监禁通常以被告未来犯罪风险为正当理由。关于犯罪预测因素的偏见性认知在多大程度上扭曲了监禁判决？我们调查了检察官对暴力犯罪再逮捕率如何随被告年龄和犯罪记录变化的看法。受访检察官存在系统性错误：他们低估了再逮捕率随年龄下降的趋势，高估了其随犯罪记录增加的趋势。通过将检察官的认知与其准随机分配的案件相关联，我们证明检察官的认知能够预测其案件中按被告年龄和犯罪记录划分的监禁模式。最后，我们发现认知更准确的检察官能够同时降低暴力再逮捕率和监禁率。（JEL D83, K14, K41, K42）
title: Prediction Errors, Incarceration, and Violent Crime: Evidence from Linking Prosecutor Surveys to Court Records
title_zh: 预测错误、监禁与暴力犯罪：来自检察官调查与法庭记录匹配的证据

abstract: We estimate the causal impacts of universal preschool by leveraging a quasi-experimental design based on Israel’s implementation of free public preschool for children ages 3 and 4 beginning in September 1999. We focus on the Arab population, who were the main beneficiaries of the first phase of the law’s implementation. Using a difference-in-differences (DID) research design, we find that universal preschool enhanced individuals’ academic performance from elementary school through high school, improved the learning environment, and increased postsecondary enrollment. Additional benefits include reduced juvenile delinquency among males and decreased early marriage among females. (JEL I21, I24, I28, J15, J16)
abstract_zh: 我们利用以色列自1999年9月起对3至4岁儿童实施免费公立学前教育的准实验设计，评估了普及型学前教育的因果影响。研究聚焦于该法律第一阶段的主要受益群体——阿拉伯人口。通过双重差分（DID）研究设计，我们发现普及型学前教育提升了个人从小学到高中的学业表现，改善了学习环境，并提高了高等教育入学率。其他益处包括降低男性青少年犯罪率和减少女性早婚现象。（JEL I21, I24, I28, J15, J16）
title: Short- and Long-Term Effects of Universal Preschool: Evidence from the Arab Population in Israel
title_zh: 以色列阿拉伯人口中普及学前教育的短期与长期效应

abstract: We examine the impact of the free supply of diphtheria antitoxin, the first effective medical treatment for an infectious disease, on the historical health transition in Massachusetts. Using newly collected municipality-level data on the distribution of antitoxin and information from over 1.5 million death certificates from 1880 to 1914, we find that the rapid availability of antitoxin treatment significantly increased life expectancy at young ages. Our findings suggest that medicine, combined with an effective public health policy, played a more important role in improving life expectancy in the early twentieth century than previously thought. (JEL H75, I12, I18, J13, N31)
abstract_zh: 本文考察了白喉抗毒素（第一种针对传染病的有效医疗手段）的免费供应对马萨诸塞州历史健康转型的影响。利用新收集的市级抗毒素分配数据以及1880年至1914年间超过150万份死亡证明信息，我们发现抗毒素治疗的快速普及显著提高了低龄人群的预期寿命。研究结果表明，在20世纪初期，医学与有效的公共卫生政策相结合，对预期寿命提升的作用比以往认知更为重要。（JEL H75, I12, I18, J13, N31）
title: Medical Technology and Life Expectancy: Evidence from the Antitoxin Treatment of Diphtheria
title_zh: 医疗技术与预期寿命：白喉抗毒素治疗的证据

abstract: Financial crimes are costly to society but less severely punished than other nonviolent crimes. We investigate whether prison sentences reduce financial crimes. Using random assignment of judges in Finland to identify causal impacts, we find a prison sentence reduces defendant reoffending by 42.9 percentage points three years postsentencing. Given prior evidence of financial misconduct “contagion,” we also explore spillovers on colleagues. A prison sentence reduces the likelihood that a financial crime defendant’s colleagues commit crimes by 27 percentage points, suggesting broader deterrent effects of harsher punishments, but only for fraud cases. Last, we show financial crimes are not victimless crimes. (JEL K14, K22, K41, K42)
abstract_zh: 金融犯罪对社会造成高昂代价，但相较于其他非暴力犯罪，其惩罚力度较轻。本文探究监禁刑罚能否减少金融犯罪。利用芬兰法官随机分配机制识别因果效应，我们发现，判决监禁使被告在判决后三年内的再犯率降低42.9个百分点。鉴于已有证据表明金融不当行为具有"传染性"，我们进一步考察了对同事的溢出效应。监禁判决使金融犯罪被告同事的犯罪概率降低27个百分点，这表明更严厉的惩罚具有更广泛的威慑效应，但该效应仅存在于欺诈案件中。最后，我们证明金融犯罪并非无受害者的犯罪。（JEL K14, K22, K41, K42）
title: Punishing Financial Crimes: The Impact of Prison Sentences on Defendants and Their Colleagues
title_zh: 惩罚金融犯罪：监禁刑期对被告及其同事的影响

abstract: Many routine daily activities—such as cooking and commuting—cause large recurring pollution spikes that may impact health without significantly affecting average exposure. We study pollution spikes by combining experimental variation in cooking technology with high-frequency data on individual pollution exposure and time-use in Kenya. Improved cookstoves reduce PM2.5 spikes while cooking by 51.3 μg/m 3 (41 percent) and cause a 0.24 standard deviation reduction in self-reported respiratory symptoms. However, even after more than three years of daily use, we find no clinical health improvements, possibly because we detect no impact on average exposure. Clinical health improvements may require reductions in ambient concentrations. (JEL I12, O12, O13, Q51, Q53)
abstract_zh: 许多日常活动（如烹饪和通勤）会引发频繁且严重的污染峰值，这些峰值可能影响健康，却不会显著改变平均暴露水平。我们通过结合烹饪技术的实验性变化与肯尼亚个体污染暴露及时间利用的高频数据，对污染峰值展开研究。改良炉灶使烹饪期间的PM2.5峰值降低51.3微克/立方米（降幅达41%），并导致自报呼吸道症状减少0.24个标准差。然而，即便经过三年以上的日常使用，我们仍未发现临床健康指标的改善，这可能是因为我们未检测到对平均暴露水平的影响。临床健康的改善或许需要降低环境本底浓度。（JEL I12, O12, O13, Q51, Q53）
title: Cooking, Health, and Daily Exposure to Pollution Spikes
title_zh: 烹饪、健康与日常污染峰值暴露
